text: {"lessons":["My account is still well above its starting value despite the recent decline, but past gains do not predict what comes next; I should judge each decision by my long-term plan.","Selling part of Stock E after a large gain did not prevent later account losses, and I cannot know whether that sale helped or hurt without the counterfactual; I should avoid treating past gains or average cost as forecasts.","Because losses bother me more than equivalent gains please me, I should keep risk and diversification aligned with my tolerance, while avoiding reactive trades based on short-term moves."]}
